question: For each key name used by instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have both system metadata and cached network info, find the maximum total vCPUs (summed across system metadata rows per instance) among those instances for that key name. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH qualifying_instances AS (
    SELECT i.uuid
    FROM instances AS i
    WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM instance_system_metadata AS ism WHERE ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM instance_info_caches AS iic WHERE iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid)
),
instance_key_vcpus AS (
    SELECT ism.`key` AS key_name, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_per_instance
    FROM qualifying_instances AS qi
    JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = qi.uuid
    JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
    GROUP BY ism.`key`, i.uuid
)
SELECT key_name, MAX(total_vcpus_per_instance) AS max_total_vcpus
FROM instance_key_vcpus
GROUP BY key_name
